question: Who among the following was the author of Kitab-ul-Hind based on India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Al Beruni**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Al Beruni:**

 
 
• Al Beruni (973-1048 CE) was a Persian scholar, polymath, and scientist.
 
• He is best known for his book "Kitab-ul-Hind" (Book of India), a comprehensive study of Indian culture, science, and philosophy.
 
• He accompanied Mahmud of Ghazni during his invasions of India.
 
• His work provides valuable insights into 11th-century India.
 
• He was a very learned man, with knowledge of many sciences.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Marco Polo:**

 
 
• Marco Polo (1254-1324 CE) was a Venetian merchant, explorer, and writer.
 
• He traveled extensively in Asia, including China, during the 13th century.
 
• His book "The Travels of Marco Polo" describes his experiences and observations.
 
• He did not write "Kitab-ul-Hind."
 
• His travels took place much later than Al Beruni's.
 
 
 
• **Abdur Razzak:**
 
 
• Abdur Razzak was a 15th-century Persian scholar and traveler.
 
• He served as an ambassador of the Timurid ruler Shah Rukh.
 
• He visited the Vijayanagara Empire in southern India.
 
• His accounts provide valuable information about the empire's culture and society.
 
• He did not write Kitab-ul-Hind.
 
 
 
• **Al Masudi:**
 
 
• Al Masudi (896-956 CE) was an Arab historian, geographer, and traveler.
 
• He is known for his work "The Meadows of Gold and Mines of Gems," a comprehensive encyclopedia of history and geography.
 
• He traveled extensively in the Middle East, Asia, and Africa.
 
• He did not write Kitab-ul-Hind.
 
• He traveled to India, but his most famous work covers a much wider area.
